measure.sourceTitle: HOTEL EMBASSY - Nairobi, Kenya - Google hotels
measure.evidenceText: Google returned HOTEL EMBASSY in Nairobi with Ksh 3,515 nightly and Ksh 4,147 total for 1 night with taxes and fees, but explicitly labels it 2-star and does not show the required explicit two-adult/one-room occupancy. Expedia returned start-from prices without one-star class; Hotels.com returned 2-star listings.
measure.searchQuery: site:google.com/travel/hotels Nairobi Kenya 1-star hotel 2 adults nightly price taxes
measure.reason: Rejected: the exact-city Google candidate is explicitly 2-star, not 1-star, and occupancy is not explicit. No same-evidence one-star property quote with the required occupancy and tax basis was exposed.
